decision: The existing rank-768 linear-plus-three-route decoder passes both locked aggregate gates when calibrated on exactly 300 already extracted records per capability with validation identities preserved. Broad decoder expansion is rejected. Authorize one existing-architecture layer-zero attention refit at the same fixed coverage, followed by the proven analytic decoder extraction.
claim_boundary: Positive read-only decoder-sufficiency evidence at a non-realizable exact-attention interface only; no extracted model, autonomous quality, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
